thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=\"inference-prod-embeddings\" severity=critical — Incident <https://pagerduty.com/incident/INC-84621|INC-84621>. Alert: embedding queue latency > 5s and 500+ queued. Auto-bridge created.
Devon: acked and taking — oncall-tz: US-West. I see repeated 503s from embedding-worker pods. Pulling logs now.
Maria: thx devon. tagging customer-facing: @Customer Success — likely impact to realtime search for 3 customers.
ops-sre: not great, seeing KV cache eviction spikes too. Could be memory pressure after latest rollout.
Devon: running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embeddings -o wide` shows 3/5 ready on eu-west and 2/4 ready on us-west. Crashloops on rsync-worker. Attaching snippet: ```stderr: OOMKilled: node memory usage > 92%```
Sam: assigning myself as secondary. Sam here — will coordinate scaling and can grab the eu-west pool.
Devon: thanks. temp mitigation: increasing HPA minReplicas to 6 for embeddings-service and kicking autoscaler: `kubectl patch hpa embeddings-hpa -p '{\"spec\":{\"minReplicas\":6}}'` — doing now.
incident-bot: Action executed: hpa patch queued by Devon. PD note appended.
Devon: also toggled prefix-KV cache flush on the canary so we don't overload the cache population. Command: `POST /admin/cache/flush?prefix=embed_canary` (internal only).
Paul: FYI noticed a downstream 429 from the redis cluster TTL expiration — might be cascading. I'll monitor redis and promote a read-replica if needed.
Customer Success: pinging impacted customers with preliminary status and ETA ~15m for mitigation to stabilize. Using template: "We're investigating elevated latency for embeddings; engineering team is actively mitigating. We'll update in 15 minutes."
Sam: eu-west pods recovering, readiness probes failing earlier due to memory pressure from a new quantization job. Disabled the batch-quantize cron on eu-west account-id 9876. Pods are cycling healthy.
Devon: traffic routing: switching EU traffic to us-west fallback pool for low-latency customers. Updating traffic policy now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-84621 changed status -> acknowledged by Devon; assigned to Devon, Sam as responder.
Sam: I'm taking primary for eu-west remediation. Devon will stay on overall coord. Handing over detailed notes: "OOM likely triggered by scheduled quantize job. Disabled cron, patched HPA, flushed prefix cache, rerouted EU traffic."
Devon: handing over to Sam — I need to jump to a customer call in 5. Sam, pls post status every 5 minutes and ping if any customer regressions.
Sam: acknowledged, taking primary. Next update in 5.
(5m later) Sam: update: eu-west metrics show CPU and memory back to pre-incident baselines; queue depth halved. No new 503s in the last 2 minutes. Routing still on fallback for a staged window.
Customer Success: forwarded update to customers; one reported improved latencies, one still seeing intermittent 2s spikes but no errors.
Devon: thanks. I'm back on audio — if anything escalates ping me @Devon. Also creating a short runbook note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/INC-84621-runbook-draft
Sam: will keep monitoring for 30m, then begin slow re-route of EU -> primary if stable.
ops-sre: adding postmortem checklist items: investigate cron scheduling safeguards, add guard for HPA runaway, add extra redis replica for peak.
Paul: I'll open a follow-up ticket for redis replica and capacity testing.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-84621 status -> resolved by Sam. Resolution note: Mitigation performed (disabled quantize cron, scaled HPA, flushed cache, rerouted traffic). Root cause suspected: scheduled quantize job causing memory pressure and cache thrash.
Sam: marking resolved. Final post-incident task list posted to channel and tagging SRE to own the follow-ups.
Devon: thanks everyone — great quick coordination.
Customer Success: customers updated that issue is resolved and that we will follow up with RCA tomorrow.
(Later) Maria: I dropped the RCA draft in the ops-docs folder, awaiting inputs from Devon/Sam/Paul. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/RCA-INC-84621
